evidence.decision: Classifies actions, further input, applied state and submenus; separates ordinary disabled discoverability from contextual hiding and permits complete dynamic sets.
evidence.artifact: Requires a command tree with actual availability/state rules or restructured menu implementation.
evidence.transformation: Ambiguous HDR On becomes explicit next-action wording, unavailable export stays dimmed and fake Sort indentation becomes a real checked submenu.
evidence.verification: Checks all-disabled children, empty selection, repeated toggling, localization and input; fails opposite labels or inaccessible real structure.
evidence.applicability: Scopes mobile icon-only shortcuts, scene-dependent visionOS breakthrough and game rendering/input checks without claiming unseen occlusion behavior.
evidence.handoffs: Routes to Context, Pop-up, Pull-down or Menu-bar procedures according to the identified menu type.
evidence.distinctiveness: Next action versus applied-state wording and discoverable disabled command organization are consequential menu semantics.
